newsitem.title: UK: London freight livens up on Atlantic grains.
newsitem.headline: London freight livens up on Atlantic grains.

text.p: The dry cargo freight market showed more signs of life, especially in the Atlantic grain trades. Brokers reported stronger demand for early Capers in the West and also for the better class of Panamax. Many believed that the Continent and US Gulf have continued to remain flat for Handy-sizes and that the formerly firm Plate/Brazil market might now weaken due to the volume of Handy tonnage ballasting in that direction. Severe weather has disrupted shipping schedules in the Northern hemisphere. The BFI rose one point to 1511.

Caper involvement in the grain trades has been significant, but full details have been slow to emerge. Amiga are understood to have taken Regina 129,882 dwt US Gulf/Egypt, and Geepee, having cancelled Theogennitor 116,978 dwt, are said to have fixed Gamal Abdel Naser 108,890 dwt instead for US Gulf/Saudi Arabia on timecharter, but further infoation is lacking. Mega dale is believed to have been fixed recently for 80,000 wheat Plate and Bahia Blanca to Iran at $28.00. Cargill were reported to have fixed and failed due to stem problems with Arctic 70,912 dwt for US Gulf/Amsterdam at $13.75 for heavy grain. Brokers report a shortage of stems in the US Gulf upto about Jan 20.

Atlantic Pride 78,000 dwt open spot Gibraltar is rumoured fixed by NNC for a transatlantic round with grain to Egypt at $11,000/11,500 daily but delivery and relivery were unknown. In the Handy-sizes Caledonian Prince 41,829 dwt was booked for 37,000/5 heavy grain Mississippi/Rotterdam for Jan 16/22 at only $13.10, and Toepfer were said to haveo have fixed their prompt 1.2/1.6m cft US Gulf/Ireland requirement on private terms.

Toepfer also covered 20,000/5 Paranagua/French Bay with options for mid-Jan shipment at about $19.00/19.50. Small bulker tonnage of 20,000/24,000 dwt was fixed for grain from the Continent to Bangladesh at about $8,250 daily for prompt loading. New business quoted included Glencore with 40,000 meals Plate and Brazil/China for Jan 15/25. In the East it was said that Pan Ocean paid about $11,000 daily for Hanjin Victoria 61,000 dwt delivery Malaysia trip via W Australia to Bin Qasim.

Nessie 110,342 dwt was rumoured fixed with ironore Tubarao/Bahrein in a firming Atlantic market for Capers. In the Panamax category fertilizer trading was active - Western Bulk Carriers were working Casablanca/Indonesia on timecharter, and Transfield were said to have bid Thetis 73,000 dwt $16,000 daily delivery prompt Bremen trip Far East. Keoyang fixed Sun P 65,738 dwt prompt Muscat for a coal voyage via Richards Bay to the continent at $7,750 daily.
Yorkgate 38,377 dwt was fixed by UBT delivery prompt Skaw trip US Gulf at a modest $6,250 daily. Angelina the Great N 40,763 dwt has fixed short period business.
